instruction: An overhead aerial photograph captures a group of people lying on a green lawn. In a wide high-angle drone shot looking straight down, ten people lie on the grass in a circle, holding hands. Among them, the man in the white shirt and beige shorts (R3) lies at the top, smiling directly up at the camera. To his right, the man in the yellow shirt and pink shorts (R1) lies with arms outstretched and eyes closed. At the bottom, the woman in the floral romper (R4) lies smiling up, while on the left, the woman in the green tank top and white pants (R2) wears a straw hat and smiles. Six other young adults in casual summer attire lie in the same circle, holding hands with the group. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused daylight, highlighting the vibrant green grass and colorful outfits.

R3 is the man smiling directly up at the overhead camera, rather than R1
